assumptions.statement: Rooms without a size from you use typical sizes for a first layout: Entrance hall 6 m², Living room 32.5 m², Kitchen and everyday dining 23 m², Dining 14 m², Pantry 4 m², Main bedroom 15 m², Bedroom for older relatives 11 m², Child's bedroom 1 11 m², Child's bedroom 2 11 m², En-suite bathroom 5 m², Accessible bathroom 7 m², Bathroom 2 6 m², Study 1 9 m², Garage 36 m², Laundry 6 m², Store room 5 m², Plant / technical room 4 m², Stair 10 m², Lift 4 m², Terrace 16 m². These are not building-code minimums; no local rules are loaded.
